# Mocksheets

> Mocksheets is an AI-powered spreadsheet assistant and mock data generator.
> Users describe what they need in natural language and receive instant,
> downloadable datasets in CSV, Excel (.xlsx), or JSON format.
> Available at https://mocksheets.com

## What Mocksheets Does

- Generates realistic mock data for software development and testing
- Creates sample CSV files and Excel spreadsheets using Claude AI
- Processes existing Excel/CSV files via natural language commands (edit, sort, filter, clean)
- Supports both Turkish and English language input
- Generates GDPR-safe fake data with no real personal information

## Key Capabilities

- Mock data generation from plain English descriptions
- Fake dataset creation (names, emails, addresses, transactions, custom schemas)
- CSV file generation with custom columns and row counts
- Excel (.xlsx) file generation with proper data types and formulas
- Test data creation with edge cases and boundary values
- AI-powered spreadsheet manipulation (sort, filter, deduplicate, highlight)

## Key Use Cases

- Developers generating test data for APIs, databases, and unit tests
- QA engineers creating comprehensive test datasets with edge cases
- Data analysts building sample datasets for demos and prototypes
- Designers populating mockups with realistic data
- Businesses generating fake customer/product/financial data for demos

## Pricing

- Free: 5 generations/day, 20/month, no credit card required
- Pro: $15/month, 30/day, 200/month
- Business: $59/month, unlimited

## Supported Output Formats

- CSV (.csv) — compatible with any tool, database, or application
- Excel (.xlsx) — compatible with Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, LibreOffice
- JSON — for API testing and developer tooling

## Technical Details

- AI model: Claude (Anthropic) via RAG pipeline
- Built with: Node.js backend, static HTML/CSS/JS frontend
- Deployed on: Vercel
- Auth: Supabase

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Is Mocksheets free?
A: Yes, the free plan includes 5 generations per day and 20 per month. No credit card required.

Q: Is the generated data GDPR-safe?
A: Yes. All generated data is entirely synthetic — no real personal information is used.

Q: What is the difference between mock data and fake data?
A: The terms are often used interchangeably. Mock data mimics a system's data structure for testing; fake data looks like real personal information but is entirely fictional. Mocksheets handles both.

Q: Can I generate data in a specific format?
A: Yes. Describe the schema, column names, data types, and row count in plain English. Mocksheets generates the data and exports it in CSV, Excel, or JSON format.

Q: What industries does Mocksheets support?
A: E-commerce, finance, HR, healthcare, SaaS, IoT, and any other domain — just describe your data needs in plain English.
